questions.q: I am always taking her sister ____.
questions.zh: 我老是把她姊姊誤認為是她。
questions.explain: her sister 是 taking 的受詞，所以用受格作受詞補語。

questions.q: He is a much better teacher than ____.
questions.zh: 跟她比起來，他是一位更優秀的老師。
questions.explain: 兩個人互相比較，格需一致，He 與 she 均為主格。

questions.q: "Whose hat is this?" "____."
questions.zh: 這是誰的帽子？
questions.explain: mine = my hat

questions.q: "John needs a pencil." "He can use one ____."
questions.zh: 「約翰需要一支鉛筆。」「他可以用我鉛筆中的一支。」
questions.explain: one of mine = one of my pencils

questions.q: This is my ticket and that is ____.
questions.zh: 這是我的車票，那是你的。
questions.explain: yours = your ticket

questions.q: We should love ____ country.
questions.zh: 我們要愛我們自己的國家。
questions.explain: own 用於所有格之後以加強語氣，主詞是第一人稱複數，故用 our own。

questions.q: I have a dog. ____ tail is very short.
questions.zh: 我有一隻狗。它的尾巴非常短。
questions.explain: 物的單數代名詞是 it，其所有格是 its。

questions.q: ____ are very intelligent.
questions.zh: 他們兩人都非常聰明。
questions.explain: 表示「兩者都……」可用 They both / Both of them。

questions.q: There are trees on ____ sides of the river.
questions.zh: 河的兩岸都有樹。
questions.explain: both 表示「兩者皆有」，如用 either 必須要接 side。

questions.q: I'm sorry I cannot find ____ of the two books you lent me.
questions.zh: 很抱歉，我找不到你借我的那兩本書。
questions.explain: not either = neither（兩者都不）

questions.q: Have you ever seen a whale alive? Yes, I've seen ____.
questions.zh: 「你曾見過活的鯨魚嗎？」「我曾看見過一條。」
questions.explain: one 代替不特定的單數名詞 ⇒ one = a + 單數名詞。

questions.q: I don't like this one; please show me ____.
questions.zh: 我不喜歡這個，請給我另一個。
questions.explain: another（另一個）。

questions.q: To say is one thing and to do is ____.
questions.zh: 說是一回事，做又是另一回事。
questions.explain: ...one thing, ...another（……一回事，……另一回事）

questions.q: I have three sisters. One is in the United States and ____ in China.
questions.zh: 我有三位姊妹。一位在美國，其餘的都在中國。
questions.explain: the others 指所剩餘的全部。

questions.q: Don't speak ill of ____ behind their backs.
questions.zh: 不要在人家背後說人家的壞話。
questions.explain: others（別人）

questions.q: New cars are much more expensive than old ____.
questions.zh: 新車比舊車貴得多。
questions.explain: ones = cars

questions.q: It was ____ that came here at midnight.
questions.zh: 半夜來這裡的是他們。
questions.explain: 原句＝They came here at midnight. 本句是用「It is ~ that...」的句型來加強語氣。

questions.q: ____ will do you good to do some exercise every morning.
questions.zh: 每天早上作些運動將對你有好處。
questions.explain: It 是形式主詞 = to do~

questions.q: We think ____ our duty to pay taxes to our government.
questions.zh: 我們認為向政府繳稅是我們的責任。
questions.explain: 代名詞 it 代替不定詞片語 to pay taxes to our government。

questions.q: The climate of Shanghai is better than ____ of Nanjing.
questions.zh: 上海的氣候比南京好。
questions.explain: that = the climate

questions.q: The cars made in China are generally cheaper than ____ imported.
questions.zh: 中國製造的汽車一般來講比進口車便宜。
questions.explain: 在比較句型中，用 that 或 those 代替前面提過的東西。此題比較的是 cars，故用 those。

questions.q: The color of my coat is different from ____ of yours.
questions.zh: 我的外套顏色不同於你的。
questions.explain: 用 that 代替前面提過的名詞 (the color)，以避免重複。

questions.q: The students of your school are more diligent than ____.
questions.zh: 你們學校的學生比我們學校的學生勤勉。
questions.explain: those = the students; mine = my school

questions.q: There are two white buildings on this street. One is the library and ____ is the hospital.
questions.zh: 這街道有兩棟白色的大樓。一棟是圖書館，另一棟是醫院。
questions.explain: 指二者用 (one... the other) 一個……另一個……。

questions.q: It doesn't matter whether there is only coffee or tea. ____ will do.
questions.zh: 只有咖啡或茶都沒關係。隨便哪個都行。
questions.explain: 兩者中任取一用 either。Either will do.（隨便哪個都行。）

questions.q: The long procession entered the hall one after ____.
questions.zh: 長長的隊伍一個接著一個地進入館內。
questions.explain: one after another（一個接一個）

questions.q: I saw him once, and ____ ten years ago.
questions.zh: 我見過他一次，是在十年前。
questions.explain: and that（而且）⇒ 代替前半句所述的事實。

questions.q: I used to refresh ____ with a cup of tea.
questions.zh: 我習慣用喝茶來提神。
questions.explain: refresh oneself（提神）。因主詞用 I，故反身代名詞用 myself。

questions.q: He believed there were no greener pastures than ____ close at hand.
questions.zh: 他相信這附近再沒有更綠的牧場了。
questions.explain: those 代替前面提過的 pastures。

questions.q: One ____ is sure to succeed in the future.
questions.zh: 努力學習者將來必定會成功。
questions.explain: One who studies hard... = Those who study hard...

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 根據中文提示，在空格內填入適當的單字或片語

questions.q:
天助自助者。
God helps ____ ____ help ____.
questions.zh: 天助自助者。
questions.explain: those who / themselves

questions.q:
敬人者，人恆敬之。
____ ____ ____ ____ will be respected by others.
questions.zh: 敬人者，人恆敬之。
questions.explain:
One who respects others ＝ Those who respect others
others ＝ other people（別人；他人）

questions.q:
任何人都不能單獨生存。
____ ____ can live ____.
questions.zh: 任何人都不能單獨生存。
questions.explain:
① No one ＝ None
② alone ＝ by oneself

questions.q:
他們在郊遊中玩的很愉快。
They ____ ____ during the picnic.
questions.zh: 他們在郊遊中玩得很愉快。
questions.explain: enjoy oneself ＝ have a good time

questions.q:
有些人富有，有些人貧窮。
____ people are rich while ____ are poor.
questions.zh: 有些人富有，有些人貧窮。
questions.explain: some..., others...（有些……，有些……）

questions.q: 大家都同意這句話：音樂能美化人生。
questions.answer: Everyone agrees that music can beautify his life.
questions.zh: 大家都同意這句話：音樂能美化人生。
questions.explain: 本句亦可用：Everyone agrees to the saying that music can beautify his life.

questions.q: 愛好音樂的人都認為他們的生活充實愉快。
answer: Music lovers think that they live a full and delightful life.
Music lovers think that they live an enriched and pleasant life.
questions.zh: 愛好音樂的人都認為他們的生活充實愉快。
questions.explain: live/lead a + 形 + life（過著……的生活）

questions.q: 因此，有許多父母讓其子女從小就學習彈鋼琴。
questions.hint: 學習彈鋼琴：learn to play the piano
questions.answer: Therefore, many parents let their children learn how to play the piano since their childhood.
questions.zh: 因此，有許多父母讓其子女從小就學習彈鋼琴。
questions.explain: since their childhood（從童年起）＝since they were children

questions.q: 音樂有多種，有人喜歡古典的，有人愛聽現代的。
questions.answer: There are many kinds of music. Some people like classical music; others like modern music.
questions.zh: 音樂有多種，有人喜歡古典的，有人愛聽現代的。
questions.explain: some..., others...（有些……，有些……）

questions.q: 週末時去聽音樂會是一種很有意義的休閒活動。
questions.hint: 有意義的休閒活動：meaningful recreation
answer: Attending a concert on weekends is a kind of meaningful activity.
Attending a concert on weekends is a kind of meaningful recreation.
questions.zh: 週末時去聽音樂會是一種很有意義的休閒活動。
questions.explain: attend a concert ＝ go to a concert

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions: 閱讀測驗：選出最適當的答案填入空格中
sections.passage: A person 1.____ that he is incapable will not make a real effort, because he feels that 2.____ would be useless. He won't go at a job with 3.____ confidence necessary for success, and he won't work hardest, 4.____ though he may think he is doing 5.____. He is therefore 6.____ to fail, and the failure will strengthen his 7.____ in his incompetence. Older people may be prevented 8.____ learning by the 9.____ belief that they are incapable of learning 10.____ because of their age.
vocabulary_hints: 2. make a real effort 真正地在努力
3. go at a job 努力去做一件工作
5. work hardest 十分認真地工作

questions.q: A person ⟦1⟧ that he is incapable will not make a real effort...
questions.zh: 相信自己無能的人不會付出真正的努力……
questions.explain:
A person [who believes (that he is incapable)] will not make...
S [形容詞子句（關係子句）] [名詞子句] 述語動詞

questions.q: ...because he feels that ⟦2⟧ would be useless.
questions.zh: 因為他覺得那樣做是無用的。
questions.explain: it 指 make a real effort 這件事情，因前面已提過，故用 it 代替。

questions.q: He won't go at a job with ⟦3⟧ confidence necessary for success...
questions.zh: 他不會帶著成功所必需的信心去從事工作……
questions.explain: 後面有形容詞修飾語 (necessary for success) 時，名詞表示特定，應加上 the。

questions.q: ...and he won't work hardest, ⟦4⟧ though he may think he is doing so.
questions.zh: 即使他可能認為自己很努力在工作……
questions.explain: even though ＝ even if ＋ S ＋ V（即便；即使）

questions.q: ...though he may think he is doing ⟦5⟧.
questions.zh: 即使他可能認為自己很努力地在工作。
questions.explain:
he is doing so ＝ he is working hardest
本句為「即使他認為自己很努力地在工作。」

questions.q: He is therefore ⟦6⟧ to fail...
questions.zh: 因此他很可能會失敗……
questions.explain: be likely to ＋ V：很可能。likely 為形容詞「可能的」。

questions.q: ...and the failure will strengthen his ⟦7⟧ in his incompetence.
questions.zh: 而失敗又會加強他對自己無能的信念。
questions.explain: 所有格 (his) ＋ 名詞 (belief)

questions.q: Older people may be prevented ⟦8⟧ learning...
questions.zh: 年長者可能會因為……而受阻無法學習……
questions.explain: prevent (人) from ＋ V-ing → (人) be prevented from ＋ V-ing（被阻止而無法……）

questions.q: ...by the ⟦9⟧ belief that they are incapable of learning anything...
questions.zh: 錯誤的念頭
questions.explain: mistaken 為形容詞修飾 belief，表「錯誤的念頭」。

questions.q: ...that they are incapable of learning ⟦10⟧ because of their age.
questions.zh: 因為年齡的關係無法學習任何東西。
questions.explain:
① 否定句、疑問句、條件句時應用 anything。
② 肯定句時用 something。
③ everything 指「一切事情或最重要的事情」。
④ nothing 指「無物（事）或不重要的事情」。
